import unittest
from count_words_in_text_code import count_words_in_text

class TestCountWordsInText(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_normal_cases(self):
        with self.subTest("Basic word count"):
            self.assertEqual(count_words_in_text("Hello World!"), 2)
        with self.subTest("Punctuation attached to words"):
            self.assertEqual(count_words_in_text("Hello,  World!"), 2)
        with self.subTest("Multiple spaces"):
            self.assertEqual(count_words_in_text("Hello   World"), 2)
        with self.subTest("Tab separated"):
            self.assertEqual(count_words_in_text("Hello\tWorld"), 2)
        with self.subTest("Newline separated"):
            self.assertEqual(count_words_in_text("Hello\nWorld"), 2)
        with self.subTest("Mixed whitespace"):
            self.assertEqual(count_words_in_text("Hello \t \n World"), 2)
        with self.subTest("Punctuation only token"):
            self.assertEqual(count_words_in_text("!!!"), 1)
        with self.subTest("Complex punctuation"):
            self.assertEqual(count_words_in_text("It's a beautiful day, isn't it?"), 5)

    def test_boundary_cases(self):
        with self.subTest("Empty string"):
            self.assertEqual(count_words_in_text(""), 0)
        with self.subTest("Whitespace only"):
            self.assertEqual(count_words_in_text("   "), 0)
        with self.subTest("Only tabs"):
            self.assertEqual(count_words_in_text("\t\t\t"), 0)
        with self.subTest("Only newlines"):
            self.assertEqual(count_words_in_text("\n\n\n"), 0)
        with self.subTest("Mixed whitespace only"):
            self.assertEqual(count_words_in_text(" \t \n "), 0)
        with self.subTest("Maximum allowed length"):
            long_text = "a " * 16000  # 16000 characters, 8000 words
            self.assertEqual(count_words_in_text(long_text), 8000)

    def test_invalid_types(self):
        with self.subTest("None input"):
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                count_words_in_text(None)
        with self.subTest("Boolean input"):
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                count_words_in_text(True)
        with self.subTest("Integer input"):
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                count_words_in_text(42)
        with self.subTest("List input"):
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                count_words_in_text(["Hello", "World"])
        with self.subTest("Dict input"):
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                count_words_in_text({"text": "Hello World"})
        with self.subTest("Float input"):
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                count_words_in_text(3.14)

    def test_length_validation(self):
        with self.subTest("Over maximum length"):
            too_long = "a" * 16001
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                count_words_in_text(too_long)
        with self.subTest("Exactly maximum length"):
            exact_length = "a " * 8000  # 16000 characters, 8000 words
            self.assertEqual(count_words_in_text(exact_length), 8000)

    def test_return_type(self):
        result = count_words_in_text("Hello World")
        self.assertIsInstance(result, int)
        self.assertEqual(result, 2)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
